purpose: Atomic evidence schema. An evidence record is the join between a source and a claim, carrying reconstructable provenance. Chain: source -> evidence assertion -> claim -> knowledge object.
one_owner_law: One fact -> one authoritative owner -> all other representations derived. Evidence never copies authoritative data owned by another registry.

id_rules.rule: Production evidence IDs MUST start with 'EVD-'. Test fixtures MUST start with 'TEST-EVD-' and set governed=false, test_fixture=true. Production inventories exclude test fixtures. A production record MUST NOT use a TEST- identifier and MUST NOT reference TEST- source/claim/entity IDs.

posture_separation.source_posture: Owned by main/data/sources/source_registry.json (status, source_lock_status). NOT stored here.
posture_separation.evidence_review_posture: Owned by THIS record. Whether this specific fact was extracted correctly, scoped correctly, and reviewed.
posture_separation.claim_posture: Owned by main/data/claims/*.json. NOT stored here.

level_rules.concept: Concept-level claim (e.g. 'Concept X has formula Y'). REQUIRES evidence_kind in {scientific, quantitative, legal_regulatory}. A terminological/lexical entry can NOT satisfy a concept-level claim.
level_rules.lexeme: Lexeme-level claim (e.g. 'source S records lexical form X'). REQUIRES evidence_kind == 'terminological' AND non-empty lexeme_ids.
level_rules.relationship: Relationship-level claim. REQUIRES a non-null 'relationship' reference (relationship_instance_id).

reference_fields_resolve_to.lexeme_ids: main/data/lexeme_registry.json (stable governed lexeme IDs; free-text is not permitted)

concept_lexeme_separation: Generic 'entities' is REPLACED by explicit 'concept_ids' (language-neutral) and optional 'lexeme_ids' (language-specific). This makes it impossible to accidentally attach a lexical source to a concept-level chemical claim: a concept-level claim requires non-terminological evidence_kind (level_rules).

forbidden_fields.source_type: REMOVED. Authoritative in source_registry.json; derive from source_id. Storing it here creates drift.
forbidden_fields.used_by: REMOVED as an editable field. Links are one-directional (knowledge objects/claims -> evidence_ids). The reverse (evidence -> consumers) is DERIVED by an index/validator.
forbidden_fields.confidence: REMOVED. Ungoverned subjective scoring is not permitted.
forbidden_fields.entities: REPLACED by concept_ids + lexeme_ids (Concept<->Lexeme resolution). Generic 'entities' hides concept-vs-lexeme semantics and is forbidden.
forbidden_fields.risk_class: REMOVED. Evidence-level 'risk' had no independent meaning distinct from route risk / claim risk / source limitations (see CONCEPT_LEXEME_MODEL.md §7). Use evidence_review_posture, source lock, allowed/prohibited_uses, temporal_scope.

missing_value_law: Absent data is stored as explicit null/missing, never synthesized. A schema is never completed by inventing a value.
records_in_this_sprint: ONE governed record: EVD-MOS2-DE-001 (lexeme-level German terminology evidence for concept molybdenum_disulfide via lexeme LEX-DE-MOS2-001). Created after the Concept<->Lexeme model was ratified and a stable governed lexeme_id exists. It changes NO source or claim status and authorizes NO route; derived Contract-C state = (not_public, noindex). Test-only fixtures live under fixtures/.
